blockers.message: Implementation must occur in the jpicklyk/task-orchestrator repository, not in dopemux-mvp. This packet records the cross-repo contract; the actual gradle test + PR live upstream.

not_run: Kotlin gradle test (./gradlew :current:test) in jpicklyk/task-orchestrator: cannot run from dopemux-mvp.
detekt static analysis on the new handler changes: cannot run from dopemux-mvp.
Live envelope round-trip against the dopemux-mvp consumer: depends on TP-DMX-ORCH-012-LIVE landing and the upstream PR merging.
Backward-compatibility snapshot diff: produced upstream once the PR is opened.
residual_risks: Upstream maintainer may choose a slightly different envelope shape; the dopemux-mvp consumer (and SUPPORTED_TRANSITION_PROOF_SCHEMA_VERSION) must be updated in lockstep if so.
Cross-repo coordination cost: this packet exists only to document the contract; the actual work is governed by the upstream repo's review process.
rollback_plan: Withdraw the upstream PR if it has not yet merged.
Once merged: revert the upstream commit; the dopemux-mvp consumer will fail closed on absent envelope and is safe.
commit_sha_policy: PLAN_ONLY bundles are committed before implementation; cross-repo implementation commit_sha will be recorded by the upstream PR's own proof bundle (proof/TP-DMX-ORCH-014A-UPSTREAM/PROOF.json in the upstream repo).
